title: WriteFreely delete/update_collection has no ownership check
description: writefreely_api.rs:302-312 (delete_collection) and lines 271-296 (update_collection). Both endpoints accept an `AuthenticatedAccount` and require `write` scope, but never verify that the authenticated user's `account_id` matches the collection's `persona_id`. Any authenticated user can update or delete any collection by alias. Fix: fetch the collection, compare `col.persona_id` to `auth.account_id`, reject if mismatched. In a single-user server this is low-severity, but it's a pattern contributors will copy for multi-user scenarios.
